rationale: Protected-line positive-sequence impedance magnitude is 26.387876 ohm. Zone 1 uses 0.80 of the protected line. Zone 2 covers the protected line plus 0.50 of the shortest remote line. Zone 3 covers the protected line plus 1.20 of the longest remote line and remains below the 0.8 load-impedance limit of 121 ohm. Delays are within the specified coordination windows and nondecreasing.
